description: Native FlexServ Gateway and Capability Servers in a Slurm allocation. Public HTTP by default; internal job-scoped mutual TLS is always enabled.

appArgs.name: enableHttps
appArgs.description: Use TAP certificate/key files for the public Gateway HTTPS listener. Omit for HTTP. Internal Gateway/FCS mutual TLS is always enabled.

appArgs.name: trustRemoteCode
appArgs.description: Only export FLEXSERV_TRUST_REMOTE_CODE=true. This release does not change backend execution or authorization.

appArgs.name: controlPlaneOnly
appArgs.description: Skip vLLM/aiperf/MAX environment installation for initial Gateway/FCS startup and shutdown checks.

schedulerOptions.name: allocation
schedulerOptions.description: The job must supply -A followed by a valid TACC allocation. No allocation is assumed by this application.

envVariables.description: Writable private model repository on the execution host.
Existing public model repository; override for your site if necessary.
TACC login forwarding with optional TAP integration.
Private userspace runtime root, owned by the job account.
